Short.Name: Short Rest
Short.Desc: Regain short-rest resources and roll Hit Dice
Short.Subtitle: Rest (1 Hour)
Short.Tooltip: Take a period of downtime, at least 1 hour long, during which a character does nothing more strenuous than eating, drinking, reading, and tending to wounds.

Long.Name: Long Rest
Long.Desc: Restore hit points, spell slots and long-rest resources
Long.Subtitle: Rest (8 Hours)
Long.Tooltip: Take a period of extended downtime, at least 8 hours long, during which a character sleeps for at least 6 hours and performs light activity for no more than 2 hours.

Notifications.SettingsReset: Nik's Action HUD: settings from an earlier version were reset to their defaults.

DisableHud.Name: Disable Action HUD
DisableHud.Hint: Completely disables and hides the Action HUD for your user account.

ConfigMenu.Name: Action HUD Configuration
ConfigMenu.Label: Configure Action HUD
ConfigMenu.Hint: Open the visual configuration panel for Action HUD themes, layout, rules, and categories.

SubmenuSide.Name: Submenu Open Direction
SubmenuSide.Hint: Direction submenus open relative to the dock. Automatic dynamically detects screen edges.

FavoritesLayout.Name: Favorites Bar Layout
FavoritesLayout.Hint: Vertical rail at the side of the HUD, or a horizontal bar above it.

InterfaceFading.Name: Fade when Idle (Interface Fading)
InterfaceFading.Hint: Dim the Action HUD when inactive, respecting core Foundry's Inactive Opacity and Fade Speed settings. Restores full opacity on hover, focus, or when a submenu is open.

CombatTurnAlert.Name: Combat Turn Alert
CombatTurnAlert.Hint: Play an attention-grabbing visual sweep and pulse across the HUD when your turn begins.

CombatTurnSound.Name: Turn Alert Sound
CombatTurnSound.Hint: Play a subtle audio chime when your turn begins.

CombatTurnNpc.Name: Alert on NPC Turns
CombatTurnNpc.Hint: Include NPC combatant turns in the visual alert when controlling them (GM only).

CloseDrawerOnUse.Name: Close Menu After Action Use
CloseDrawerOnUse.Hint: Dismiss the open drawer right after you use an attack, spell, or item.

HideEmptyDrawers.Name: Hide Empty Submenus
HideEmptyDrawers.Hint: Hides action buttons and submenus that have no entries for the active actor (e.g. hiding the Spells button for non-spellcasters).

ToolChecks.Name: Show Tool Checks
ToolChecks.Hint: Display tool checks below skill checks in the Abilities menu, matching the character sheet layout.

AbilityOrder.Name: Abilities Menu Order
AbilityOrder.Hint: Order of the saving throw, skill and ability check groups in the Abilities menu.

WizardRituals.Name: Show Unprepared Wizard Rituals
WizardRituals.Hint: Displays unprepared spells that have the ritual tag in the Spellbook for wizard characters, allowing them to cast ritual spells directly from their spellbook.

DamageTypeDisplay.Name: Damage Type Display
DamageTypeDisplay.Hint: Choose how damage types are displayed on action buttons: compact subtly colored icons, icons with text, or written text only.

AutoFavoriteNpc.Name: Auto-Favorite NPC Actions
AutoFavoriteNpc.Hint: When an NPC token with no favorites is placed on the scene, automatically favorite its attacks and other combat actions (D&D 5e: items with an attack, damage or save; Shadowdark: attacks, special attacks and spells).

AutoFavoriteNpcMax.Name: Auto-Favorite Max Actions
AutoFavoriteNpcMax.Hint: Only auto-favorite when an NPC has this many qualifying actions or fewer (default 6).

AutoFavoriteNpcAttacks.Name: Always Favorite Attacks
AutoFavoriteNpcAttacks.Hint: Even when an NPC has more qualifying actions than the maximum, still auto-favorite its attacks.

GroupByActivation.Name: Group Actions by Activation Type
GroupByActivation.Hint: Sort and section actions into Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, and Legendary Action headers.

FontFamily.Name: Action HUD Font
FontFamily.Hint: Typography used for button labels, item headers, and submenus.

ButtonShape.Name: Category Button Shape
ButtonShape.Hint: Override category button geometry with any theme's button shape.

HudOpacity.Name: HUD Opacity
HudOpacity.Hint: How opaque the HUD's panels, buttons and tooltips are. Lower it to see the canvas through the HUD; text and icons stay fully visible.

TooltipScale.Name: Tooltip Text Size
TooltipScale.Hint: Adjust the scale of rich action hover cards and item tooltips.

PortraitSource.Name: Portrait Image Source
PortraitSource.Hint: Which image the HUD portrait shows: the actor's character sheet portrait or the token art. Players can still override this per character from the portrait's right-click menu.

Shadowdark.LuckTooltip: Spend Luck to reroll any roll you just made. You must take the new result.
Shadowdark.SpendLuckConfirm: Do you want to spend a Luck point to reroll your last check or test?

Text.LuckTip: Spend Luck to reroll any roll you just made. You must take the new result.
Text.RollHpTip: Roll max and current hit points for this NPC based on level and CON modifier.
Text.InitiativeTip: Roll initiative to determine turn order in combat. In Shadowdark, initiative is rolled each combat round on d20 + DEX modifier.
Text.LostBadgeTitle: Spell failed and lost until long rest
Text.FocusTitle: Requires Focus (broken if damaged or casting another focus spell)
Text.RestoreFooter: Click 'Restore' or take a Long Rest to regain
Text.LightOnTip: Illuminates a 30-foot radius. Real-time dungeon turn tracking is active.
Text.LightOffTip: Extinguished light source. Ignite when entering the dark.
Text.FavFooter: Drag to reorder · Right-Click to remove

ToggleVisibility.Name: Show/Hide Action HUD
ToggleVisibility.Hint: Shows or hides the Action HUD.

IconPicker.Title: Icon picker
IconPicker.ValuePlaceholder: Font Awesome classes, an emoji or an image path
IconPicker.Refine: Showing the first results. Narrow the search to see the rest.
IconPicker.ImageHint: Any image from this world works as an icon. It is drawn at the size of the text around it.

Scope.WorldTitle: Applies to every player at the table

Footer.NoChanges: No unsaved changes · preview is live

Excluded.Title: Excluded actor types
Excluded.Hint: The HUD stays hidden while you control a checked actor type.

Menu.Desc: Customize the order, labels and icons of the category buttons on your Action HUD.
Menu.NavTopHint: Show this drawer's tabs in a row above the list
Menu.NavSideHint: Show this drawer's tabs in a column beside the list

Backup.ExportDesc: Back up your whole configuration (theme, behavior, position and custom categories) as a JSON file, or load one from another world or machine. An imported file is applied when you save.
Backup.ResetHint: Restores every setting, the HUD position and the category layout. This cannot be undone.

Panel.GmOnly: Only a GM can change this.
